motion_specs.lenis_scroll: Implement Smooth Lenis Scrolling for weighted momentum

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, links, modals) MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts URL provided in design_guidelines.json into public/index.html or index.css
Ensure all copy is fluently written in Bahasa Indonesia with romantic & professional wedding tone
Use Lenis scroll library (or smooth CSS scroll fallback) for premium momentum scrolling
Implement light and dark mode state cleanly using CSS variables
Make sure all interactive elements contain data-testid attributes
Use Lucide-react or Radix icons for clean visual cues
Add toast notification on form submit / copy links via Sonner toast component
